summary.text: First of the Trojans whom peerless Teucer laid on the bounteous earth when Ajax covered him with his shining shield — a namesake of Orsilochus the Pylians' king and of Crethon's brother whom Aeneas slew.

story.text: Whom first then of the Trojans did peerless Teucer slay? Orsilochus — then Ormenus, Ophelestes, Daetor, Chromius, godlike Lycophontes, Amopaon, and Melanippus, one after another, while Agamemnon waxed glad at the havoc in the battalions.
